'''Mon Gazza''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mon Gazza system/Legends|Mon Gazza system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] and featured [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]].

==History==
[[File:Mon_Gazza.png|left|thumb|Mon Gazza as seen from orbit]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Mon Gazza was once home to a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony, second only to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in spice mining production. A violent, poverty-stricken world, it was controlled by the [[Galactic Spice Mining Guild]]. Mon Gazza was also the homeworld of the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zett Jukassa/Legends|Zett Jukassa]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Mon Gazza was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

===Podracing===
[[File:MonGazza.jpg|left|thumb|[[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] on Mon Gazza.]]
Barren, dusty, and red, Mon Gazza's only other notable features were the [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] held there in its prime, before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] outlawed the dangerous sport. Some of the races were held in unused spice mines that had been opened for the races. The tracks include [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Speedway]], [[Spice Mine Run]], [[Zugga Challenge/Legends|Zugga Challenge]], and [[Mon Gazza Maze/Legends|Mon Gazza Maze]].

===Nagai invasion===
Mon Gazza was the site of a [[Battle of Mon Gazza (Nagai invasion)|battle]] against [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] invaders in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
